text: Ulster County is buying actuarial services for its Self-Insurance Plan, covering County Government, municipalities, school districts, and volunteer firefighters.

citations.text: COUNTY OF ULSTER
ACTUARIAL SERVICES FOR ULSTER COUNTY

The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.

text: The County seeks a qualified actuarial firm to provide annual valuation of its self-insured workers’ compensation program.

citations.text: The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.

text: The plan was established under New York State Workers’ Compensation Law and Local Law #1 of 1979, amended by Local Law #10 of 2008.

citations.text: In accordance with the provisions of the New York State Workers’ Compensation Law, Ulster County established a pooled Self-Insurance Plan by Local Law #1 of 1979.

text: The plan covers County employees, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

citations.text: The plan provides coverage to employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts within the County, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

text: County employees administer the plan with a third-party administrator, under the County Executive’s oversight.

citations.text: The administration of this plan is accomplished with County employees in conjunction with a Third-party administrator and is overseen by the County Executive.

citations.text: In accordance with Local Law 6 of 2021 also known as the Ulster County Living Wage Act, if this Agreement is for an amount of FIFTY THOUSAND and 00/100 ($50,000.00) DOLLARS or more in a County fiscal year (January 1 – December 31) and the Firm has not received an exemption from the Ulster County Living Wage Act specific to this Agreement, the Firm shall pay its employees that are working or providing services under this Agreement no less than the Living Wage in effect during the term of this Agreement.
